name: Defold · sprite-atlas
note: One zipped Defold project dropped into a project's drop/ folder has its atlases compiled and the texture outputs copied into out/. The lane runs bob.jar (engine sha 574678c7, Defold 1.13.1) under Defold's own JDK 25, focused on the atlases with --build-input; the engine.run receipt cites the input, the source PNG sha256, every compiled texture and the Defold env-lock.

rows.label: project
rows.note: game.project at the zip root; at least one .atlas or .tilesource inside

rows.label: staged
rows.note: an atlas or image alone cannot compile; zip it with its project (rules: stage)

rows.label: 2 hash sources
rows.note: parsed from the atlas text, PNG size from IHDR

rows.label: 3 build
rows.note: run.mjs atlas · focused build; a full build if that fails (report: focused=false)

rows.label: texture
rows.note: image · the packed atlas texture bob compiled

rows.label: report
rows.note: atlases, source images (sha256, size), compiled files (bytes, sha256), focused, engine sha, bob version

rows.label: cites
rows.value: input sha256 · texture output sha256s · env-lock sha256 · template shas
rows.note: sealed in the root store by the lane

rows.label: extra
rows.value: atlas_count · atlas_paths · source_images · png_sha256 · compiled_count · compiled_bytes · focused · engine_sha · bob_version

rows.label: acceptance
rows.value: texturec + texturesetc per atlas · report names images and outputs · receipt cites input, outputs, png sha, env-lock
